['Iveco Magirus AG '].company_description: Iveco Magirus AG, now part of Iveco Group, is a global leader in commercial and specialty vehicles, powertrain, and related financial services. It is known for its innovative fire engines and firefighting equipment, and also provides vocational training opportunities. The company has a highly innovative product portfolio and is involved in educating secondary school graduates about vocational training. Iveco Group employs over 35,000 people worldwide and has a significant manufacturing and R&D presence.

['Wabco Holding GmbH '].company_description: WABCO Holdings, Inc. is a provider of electronic braking, stability, suspension, and transmission automation systems for heavy-duty commercial vehicles. Their products are present in trucks, buses, trailers, and off-highway vehicles, and the company aims to be the preferred global technology partner to the commercial vehicle industry.
